Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang, arXiv2609.06905v1 AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.2. Bounded continuous real tests and explicit4M² domination are ASTIS elaborations of source compactly supported continuous tests; no all-L2 or main-theorem credit.
Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. For every fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0 and each finite nonnegative t, the phase-flow defect event D_t={sample:Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)≠Φ_t(z0)} is measurable and satisfies P(D_t)≤1−exp(−Λ(z0,t)). For every real δ>0, the event A_(δ,t)={sample:δ≤‖Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)−z0‖} is measurable for all finite nonnegative t, and P(A_(δ,t)) tends to zero as t tends to zero in the nonnegative real domain, including the value t=0. The phase norm is the literal product norm on E×E, giving its finite-dimensional phase topology; no quantitative norm-distance rate is asserted. In addition, for this same single phase map Z and each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, take any continuous real-valued function f on E×E and any real M≥0 such that |f(z)|≤M for every phase z. For every finite t≥0, the actual sample function f(Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)) is Borel measurable and integrable under the same canonical probability measure P. Its expectation obeys |∫ f(Z_t) dP−f(Φ_t(z0))|≤2M[1−exp(−Λ(z0,t))]. Moreover ∫ f(Z_t) dP tends to f(z0) as nonnegative t tends to0 in the ordinary nonpunctured neighborhood filter, including the value at0. The bound is valid for every admissible nonnegative M, including M=0; no uniform limit over parameters or tests is asserted. This bounded-continuous real test class C_b and explicit quantitative2M bound are attributed ASTIS elaborations of the compactly supported continuous test argument in Chen-Chewi-Lu-Zhang AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.1-p6.2, not quoted source theorems. The proof integrates a bounded discrepancy over the actual phase-flow defect event; it neither identifies that event with the first-event event nor invokes almost-sure convergence from convergence in probability. No unbounded-test expectation or expected oracle cost follows. All six original analytic source conditions and eleven literal actual definitions remain, and no process, probability, integral or limit certificate is a premise. In addition, define the exact conditional position probability q_y=volume.tilted(x↦−V(x)−‖x−y‖²/(2η)) and the initial phase probability ν_y=q_y⊗N(0,I_E). Both probability normalizations are conclusions derived from the same six analytic hypotheses. For each fixed y,xRef, each continuous real f:E×E→ℝ and every M≥0 with |f(z)|≤M for all z, define the actual clock expectation A_t f(z)=∫_Ω f(Z(y,xRef,z,t,sample))P(dsample). For every finite t≥0, A_t f is Borel measurable in z; z↦(A_t f(z)−f(z))² is ν_y-integrable and obeys the pointwise bound (A_t f(z)−f(z))²≤4M² for every phase z. Moreover ∫(A_t f(z)−f(z))²ν_y(dz)→0 as t→0 in the ordinary nonpunctured neighborhood filter on nonnegative reals. The same single existential actual phase Z is used for every test, bound and initial state. These outputs hold for every deterministic y and xRef without any phase-invariance premise. This is the bounded continuous real test subclass, an attributed ASTIS extension of the authors compactly supported continuous test ingredient in AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.2. It is not the general L² equivalence-class operator theorem. Full invariant-law and AE-representative semantics, contraction/Jensen, C_c density and extension to every L² test, restart/Markov/semigroup, hypocoercivity, implementation/error/unbounded cost, actual-input composition and full main results remain separate OPEN obligations.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun sample k => Real.toNNReal (sample k)
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
    let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
    let eventTime : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef z₀ e n => (record y xRef z₀ e n).elim
        (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)
    ∃ Z : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → (ℕ → ℝ) → (E × E),
      Measurable (fun a : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 × (ℕ → ℝ) =>
        Z a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ sample : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
        ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),
          eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) →
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1) →
          record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = Sum.inl a →
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ sample : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ t : ℝ≥0,
        (¬ ∃ n : ℕ, eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1)) →
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = z₀) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ᵐ sample ∂P,
        (∀ t : ℝ≥0, ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E),
          eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n ≤ (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
          (t : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ (ε sample) (n + 1) ∧
          record y xRef z₀ (ε sample) n = Sum.inl a ∧ a.1 ≤ t ∧
          ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0) < τ y xRef a.2 (ε sample n) ∧
          Z y xRef z₀ t sample = Φ y xRef ((t - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
        Z y xRef z₀ 0 sample = z₀)
 ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E,
        (∀ t : ℝ≥0,
          MeasurableSet {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            Z y xRef z₀ t sample ≠ Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀} ∧
          P.real {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            Z y xRef z₀ t sample ≠ Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀} ≤
              1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t)) ∧
        (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ →
          (∀ t : ℝ≥0, MeasurableSet {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            δ ≤ ‖Z y xRef z₀ t sample - z₀‖}) ∧
          Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => P.real {sample : ℕ → ℝ |
            δ ≤ ‖Z y xRef z₀ t sample - z₀‖}) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)))

 ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E,
        ∀ f : (E × E) → ℝ, Continuous f →
        ∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → (∀ z : E × E, |f z| ≤ M) →
          (∀ t : ℝ≥0,
            Measurable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)) ∧
            Integrable (fun sample : ℕ → ℝ => f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample)) P ∧
            |(∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P) -
                f (Φ y xRef (t : ℝ) z₀)| ≤
              2 * M * (1 - Real.exp (-Λ y xRef z₀ t))) ∧
          Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 => ∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P)
            (𝓝 0) (𝓝 (f z₀)))


 ∧
      (let q : E → Measure E := fun y =>
         (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x - ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η))
       let ν : E → Measure (E × E) := fun y => (q y).prod (stdGaussian E)
       (∀ y : E, IsProbabilityMeasure (q y) ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure (ν y)) ∧
       (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ f : (E × E) → ℝ, Continuous f →
         ∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → (∀ z : E × E, |f z| ≤ M) →
           let A : ℝ≥0 → (E × E) → ℝ := fun t z₀ =>
             ∫ sample, f (Z y xRef z₀ t sample) ∂P
           (∀ t : ℝ≥0, Measurable (A t) ∧
             Integrable (fun z₀ : E × E => (A t z₀ - f z₀) ^ 2) (ν y) ∧
             (∀ z₀ : E × E, (A t z₀ - f z₀) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * M ^ 2)) ∧
           Tendsto (fun t : ℝ≥0 =>
             ∫ z₀, (A t z₀ - f z₀) ^ 2 ∂(ν y)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)))
decoder_context: All displayed functions and objects are literal definitions. The potential is real-valued on a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure; dimension zero is allowed. The six analytic hypotheses are the only supplied mathematical premises. fderiv is the Frechet derivative, gradient is the real inner-product gradient, and ContDiff real 2 means twice continuously differentiable.

expMeasure 1 is the rate-one exponential measure on the real line. infinitePi is the canonical countable product on all real sequences. toNNReal is max(x,0) viewed as a nonnegative real, including exceptional nonpositive coordinates.

hittingAfter f s 0 a denotes the infimum of nonnegative times at which f(t)(a) belongs to s, with infinity for an empty hit set. WithTop NNReal includes a greatest element top. untopD 0 returns the finite value when finite, and zero at top; the guard branches before evaluating a finite-state update.

Sum.inl stores a finite accumulated time and state pair. Sum.inr Unit is the absorbing stopped record, represented by eventTime top and carrying no state at infinity. Nat.rec initializes at (0,z0) and uses coordinate k in update k to k+1.

Products associate to the right. Measurable means Borel measurable for the displayed finite-dimensional, nonnegative-time and countable product measurable structures. NNReal subtraction is max(t-s,0). A quantified function witness is a total map; no measurable selection or trajectory is supplied as an assumption.

Measure.real is the real measure value of an event. Product norm gives the phase topology. The integral is the Bochner integral under the displayed measure. Every real continuous test f and every real nonnegative global absolute bound M are quantified after the single existential phase map. Tendsto with nhds0 on NNReal is the ordinary nonpunctured zero-time filter within nonnegative times.

Measure.tilted is the normalized exponential tilt with totalized zero convention when the normalizer vanishes; IsProbabilityMeasure is a mathematical output here. stdGaussian E is the identity-covariance standard Gaussian probability on E. Measure.prod is the independent product measure. Both inner and outer integrals are the Bochner integral under the literal displayed laws. A is the actual clock expectation, indexed by initial phase. The outer integrand is its squared difference from f.

lesson.lean_statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Allow arbitrary parameters y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. There exists a total phase map Z:E×E×(E×E)×[0,∞)×Ω→E×E jointly Borel measurable in all displayed parameters, finite physical time t and sample, while V,α,β,η remain fixed. For every parameter triple, every sample, every finite t and any actual covering index n with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), if record_n=inl(a) with a=(s,z), then Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z), where subtraction is the NNReal nonnegative subtraction. If no such actual covering index exists, Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=z0. This uncovered value is an explicitly chosen ASTIS total representative convention, not a source state supplied on exceptional inputs. Furthermore, for each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample simultaneously: for every finite nonnegative t there exist n and an actual finite live record a=(s,z) with T_n≤t<T_(n+1), record_n=inl(a), s≤t, t−s<τ(z,ε_n) and Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)=Φ_(t−s)(z); and Z(y,xRef,z0,0,sample)=z0. A stopped record never provides the source phase. An infinite next wait retains the last live harmonic arc for all later finite t and does not trigger the uncovered fallback. The AE event may depend on the fixed parameter triple; no uniform event over all parameters is asserted. Joint measurability permits later measurable parameter evaluation, but per-parameter AE agreement cannot be substituted at arbitrary parameters correlated with sample without a separate law/independence/conditional-kernel argument. For every fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0 and each finite nonnegative t, the phase-flow defect event D_t={sample:Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)≠Φ_t(z0)} is measurable and satisfies P(D_t)≤1−exp(−Λ(z0,t)). For every real δ>0, the event A_(δ,t)={sample:δ≤‖Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)−z0‖} is measurable for all finite nonnegative t, and P(A_(δ,t)) tends to zero as t tends to zero in the nonnegative real domain, including the value t=0. The phase norm is the literal product norm on E×E, giving its finite-dimensional phase topology; no quantitative norm-distance rate is asserted. In addition, for this same single phase map Z and each fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0, take any continuous real-valued function f on E×E and any real M≥0 such that |f(z)|≤M for every phase z. For every finite t≥0, the actual sample function f(Z(y,xRef,z0,t,sample)) is Borel measurable and integrable under the same canonical probability measure P. Its expectation obeys |∫ f(Z_t) dP−f(Φ_t(z0))|≤2M[1−exp(−Λ(z0,t))]. Moreover ∫ f(Z_t) dP tends to f(z0) as nonnegative t tends to0 in the ordinary nonpunctured neighborhood filter, including the value at0. The bound is valid for every admissible nonnegative M, including M=0; no uniform limit over parameters or tests is asserted. This bounded-continuous real test class C_b and explicit quantitative2M bound are attributed ASTIS elaborations of the compactly supported continuous test argument in Chen-Chewi-Lu-Zhang AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.1-p6.2, not quoted source theorems. The proof integrates a bounded discrepancy over the actual phase-flow defect event; it neither identifies that event with the first-event event nor invokes almost-sure convergence from convergence in probability. No unbounded-test expectation or expected oracle cost follows. All six original analytic source conditions and eleven literal actual definitions remain, and no process, probability, integral or limit certificate is a premise. In addition, define the exact conditional position probability q_y=volume.tilted(x↦−V(x)−‖x−y‖²/(2η)) and the initial phase probability ν_y=q_y⊗N(0,I_E). Both probability normalizations are conclusions derived from the same six analytic hypotheses. For each fixed y,xRef, each continuous real f:E×E→ℝ and every M≥0 with |f(z)|≤M for all z, define the actual clock expectation A_t f(z)=∫_Ω f(Z(y,xRef,z,t,sample))P(dsample). For every finite t≥0, A_t f is Borel measurable in z; z↦(A_t f(z)−f(z))² is ν_y-integrable and obeys the pointwise bound (A_t f(z)−f(z))²≤4M² for every phase z. Moreover ∫(A_t f(z)−f(z))²ν_y(dz)→0 as t→0 in the ordinary nonpunctured neighborhood filter on nonnegative reals. The same single existential actual phase Z is used for every test, bound and initial state. These outputs hold for every deterministic y and xRef without any phase-invariance premise. This is the bounded continuous real test subclass, an attributed ASTIS extension of the authors compactly supported continuous test ingredient in AppendixA.1 Ex22 p6.2. It is not the general L² equivalence-class operator theorem. Full invariant-law and AE-representative semantics, contraction/Jensen, C_c density and extension to every L² test, restart/Markov/semigroup, hypocoercivity, implementation/error/unbounded cost, actual-input composition and full main results remain separate OPEN obligations.
